# Rotaract Club of Lalitpur

> Rotaract Club of Lalitpur is a youth-led community service club in Lalitpur, Nepal, chartered on December 28, 1998 under Rotary International District 3292. Motto: "Perceive & Excel." The club runs community service, fellowship, and cultural preservation projects and is open to members aged 18+.

## Key facts

- Chartered: December 28, 1998 (27+ years active)
- District: Rotary International District 3292
- Membership fee: NPR 500
- Age range: 18+ years
- Meetings: Every alternate Saturday, T&B Restaurant, Balkumari, Lalitpur
- Email: lalitpur@rotaract3292.org
- Phone: +977-9818706474

- [Home](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/): Overview of the club, impact, and signature projects.
- [About](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/about): Club history, mission, leadership, and past presidents.
- [Projects](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/projects): Signature service projects — Candle Walk, Nyano Maya, Matya Health Camp, Lumanti Magazine.
- [Gallery](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/gallery): Photos from club events and projects.
- [Join](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/join): How to become a member.
- [Contact](https://raclalitpur.vercel.app/contact): Contact details and inquiry form.
